title: 12 Best Craft Beer in Queenstown
description: Discover the top 12 craft beer spots in Queenstown, New Zealand. From dedicated breweries with scenic views to cozy gastropubs, find your perfect pint in 2026.

places.name: Altitude Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A tasting paddle of their seasonal brews, especially the 'Sled Dog' IPA or 'Dark Peak' Stout, paired with loaded fries.

places.name: Smiths Craft Beer House
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Start with a local NZ craft beer from Garage Project or Behemoth, and don't miss their famous gourmet burgers or buffalo wings.

places.name: Canyon Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Canyon Pale Ale' or a seasonal specialty, paired with the Slow-Cooked Lamb Shoulder – truly exceptional.

places.name: Searchlight Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a 'KPA (Kiwi Pale Ale)' or 'Luma' (Lager) and a classic pepperoni pizza – a perfect combo.

places.name: Atlas Beer Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pint of your favourite New Zealand IPA and their famous Atlas Steak Sandwich with a side of fries.

places.name: Queenstown Beerhouse
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for their latest seasonal tap or a flight of New Zealand's finest, paired with their hearty Nachos or a Beef Burger.

places.name: Frank's Eatery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their regularly changing local craft taps (often from Altitude or Canyon) alongside their famous 'Frank's Fried Chicken' or a hearty salad.

places.name: Yonder
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a local NZ Lager or Pale Ale, perfect with their 'Yonder Bowl' or the 'Halloumi & Corn Fritters'.

places.name: Pub on Wharf
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Speight's Gold Medal Ale' if you're feeling traditional, or one of their local craft guest taps, alongside their famous Fish and Chips.

places.name: Ferg's Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Whatever local craft beer is currently on tap, often from Altitude or Canyon. Pair it with a classic Fergburger (from next door!).

places.name: The Gold Standard
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for their current craft beer tap; it's always a premium local brew. Enjoy it with their exquisite small plates.

places.name: Vista
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their craft pale ales or lagers, which frequently include local favourites, along with their 'Chargrilled Sirloin' or a fresh seasonal salad.
